Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 breathing mask 
 ... etc.

Installed on fuel oil tanks consisted of three 
 voltage transformer rectifiers every rectifier feed one tank.

Installed on condenser cooling water pipes and 
 service cooling water pipes

Installed on condenser water box for steam 
 turbine plant and consisting of iron plates, fixed to the tube sheet, is 
 provided inside the water boxes to protect tubes and tube sheets and the 
 inside surface of the water boxes is coated with epoxy (600 microns thick) for 
 corrosion protection. studs for the installation of four sacrificial anodes 
 per water box are installed.
